emotional_tone: Established, distinct, crafted, understated elegance, premium.
design_concept: Dramatic Opulence meets Earthy Organic. Deep, rich blacks combined with subtle gray-on-black Celtic motifs. Clean, pared-down layouts (inspired by Kerry Hill Winery) but elevated with dark rich premium tones and editorial typography.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32 for editorial breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Asymmetrical layout for 'Our Story' and 'Featured Wines'. Avoid standard bootstrap columns. Use CSS Grid with wide gaps (gap-12 to gap-16).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align paragraphs and dense content for readability. Center-align hero statements and editorial pull-quotes.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-surface), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) with border color darkening/lightening.
surface_strategies.celtic_dividers: 1px horizontal border-white/10 with a subtle, geometric Celtic-inspired SVG knot centered. Heritage texture, not theme-park styling.
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Used sparingly for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10 bottom edge.

celtic_influence_guidelines.implementation: Do not use bright green or overt shamrocks. Use soft gray-on-black low-contrast decorative motifs as background tiles (opacity 3%), understated section dividers, and heritage-inspired ornamental framing on 'Our Story' and 'Wine Club' sections.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for overlapping, asymmetrical, creative layouts.
components_strategy.interactive_logic: Shadcn UI (Input, Select, Form, Dialog) heavily customized to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Match the luxury dark theme.
components_strategy.admin_cms: Shadcn UI components (Tables, Cards, Tabs) in a dense, functional layout. 'Control Room' grid.
components_strategy.javascript_note: Provide guidelines and implementations tailored for .js and .jsx files, not .tsx.
components_strategy.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='inquiry-submit-button').

pages.Home: Hero with strong winery imagery + concise brand statement; Intro/story section with heritage cues; Featured wines/current releases grid; Current Features section for Train Graffiti Art Series; Visit/appointment CTA; Wine Club preview; latest news posts; contact/purchase inquiry CTA.
pages.Our Wines: Listing page, editorial bento grid, rich imagery.
pages.Wine Detail: Individual wine detail pages with label close-ups, tasting notes, vintage, appellation, availability. Inquiry CTA.
pages.How to Buy: Inquiry-based (contact form only), no e-commerce cart.
pages.Visit: Visit page with hours + appointment CTA.
pages.Our Story: Light-touch label history, heritage texture, cellar imagery.
pages.Wine Club: Informational with two options: Reds Only and All Wines. Inquiry CTA.
pages.Train Graffiti Art Series: Dedicated feature page. Blends urban art with premium wine aesthetic.
pages.Contact & Newsletter: Contact page with inquiry form (purchase/club/visit/general) and newsletter signup form.
pages.Admin/CMS: Dashboard for wines, page content, news posts, media, submissions.
